results.title: Guangzhou natural resources department cadastral map enquiry
results.note: Says anyone may consult cadastral maps spatially or by certificate and see parcel/ownership classes and areas; does not establish downloadable open geometry or anonymous feature API.

assessment: Chinese-language search found an official cadastral-map enquiry portal and a general open-data catalog. It did not verify public parcel-vector download or a stable-ID feature query.
note: Native-language discovery only; does not change the historical registry or assert that no source exists.
